# yarn-cache

Yarn's download cache. Yarn downloads packages again when needed.

**Name:** Yarn cache · **Category:** Package caches · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux, Windows

Upstream docs: <https://classic.yarnpkg.com/en/docs/cli/cache>

**Detected when** one of `yarn` is on PATH or one of `{classic}`, `{berry}` exists.

## Paths

Resolved in this order: the tool's own command, then the environment variable, then the system default.

- `{berry}`: default `~/.yarn/berry/cache`
- `{classic}`: `yarn cache dir` → `$YARN_CACHE_FOLDER` → macOS `~/Library/Caches/Yarn` → Linux `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/yarn` → Windows `%LOCALAPPDATA%/Yarn/Cache`

## Locations

| Path | Item | Safety | Why | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{classic}` | Yarn cache | Safe | This is a download cache; it is fetched again when needed (`REDOWNLOADABLE`) | `native:yarn-cache-clean`, `quarantine` |
| `{berry}` | Yarn global cache | Safe | This is a download cache; it is fetched again when needed (`REDOWNLOADABLE`) | `quarantine` |

## Native commands

- `native:yarn-cache-clean` runs `yarn cache clean` (timeout 600 s, freed space measured before and after)
